facts.text: I am trying to get organized and keep track of all the birthdays and milestones in my friends' and family's lives.
I heard that my friend from college, David, had a baby boy named Jasper a few weeks ago.
I use Google Calendar for work and personal appointments.
I want to set up a separate Google Calendar for friends and family birthdays.
I want to add a note or description to each birthday event, such as a phone number or address.
I want to add David's phone number to the calendar.
I want to add a note to send a congratulatory message to David and his wife on Jasper's birthday.
I want to reach out to David and his wife on Jasper's birthday and catch up.
I want to add my cousin Rachel's son Max to the calendar.
I want to add my friends Mike and Emma's daughter Charlotte to the calendar.
Charlotte was born around the same time as Max.
I want to add my aunt's twins, Ava and Lily, to the calendar.
Ava and Lily were born in April.
I want to add my friend Sarah's adopted daughter Aaliyah to the calendar.
I want to add my neighbor's adopted dog Rocky's gotcha day to the calendar.

keyphrases: phone number and address in event
aunt twins Ava and Lily born April
